enunciado: Implement naive search findSubstring(text, pattern, from) and use it to list all positions of "ana" in "bananas y ananas". Compare the first one with index_of.
objetivos: Compare a pattern at every possible position
pistas: Candidate positions go from 'from' to n - m.
Compare character by character and give up at the first mismatch.
For the next occurrence search from the found position + 1.
